sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN outdoor_temp_c < 15 THEN '<15' WHEN outdoor_temp_c BETWEEN 15 AND 25 THEN '15-25' ELSE '>25' END AS outdoor_temp_band, COUNT(*) AS total_incidents, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN false_alarm = true THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS false_alarm_share_percent FROM sf_ops.incidents WHERE kind = 'machine_overheat' GROUP BY CASE WHEN outdoor_temp_c < 15 THEN '<15' WHEN outdoor_temp_c BETWEEN 15 AND 25 THEN '15-25' ELSE '>25' END ORDER BY total_incidents DESC
LIMIT 200
